title: Unexpected Analytic Phenomena on Finsler Manifolds
summary: In the Riemannian setting, every flat Cartan--Hadamard manifold is isometric to Euclidean space, the canonical model that underlies the theory of Sobolev spaces and guarantees the sharpness/rigidity of the Hardy inequality, the uncertainty principle, and the Caffarelli--Kohn--Nirenberg (CKN) inequality. In this paper, we show that on a flat Finsler Cartan--Hadamard manifold -- Berwald's metric space -- the classical picture alters radically: the Nash embedding theorem fails, the Sobolev space becomes nonlinear, and the Hardy and uncertainty inequalities break down completely, whereas the CKN…
